key_insight: LingBot-World 2.0 (LingBot-World-Infinity) extends interactive AI to an effectively unbounded horizon without losing consistency or responsiveness. It combines long-range causal pretraining with a distilled real-time variant that can sustain 720p video at 60 fps.
problem_solved: The paper tackles the challenge of building a world model/interactive agent that can keep generating high-quality outputs over very long or infinite interaction sequences while still responding fast enough for real-time use.
method: Uses a carefully designed causal pretraining paradigm to support unbounded interaction length.
Distills a real-time variant from the base model for low-latency inference.
Targets high-throughput interactive generation, including 720p video streaming at 60 fps.
impact: This work is important for practitioners building interactive AI systems, simulation agents, and real-time generative models because it addresses both long-horizon consistency and deployment speed. It points toward world models that are practical for continuous, real-time applications.
visual_elements: A pipeline diagram showing causal pretraining -> base model -> real-time distilled model.
A timeline/interaction horizon graphic illustrating finite vs unbounded sequence generation.
A latency and throughput chart highlighting 720p 60 fps performance.
An architecture icon set comparing quality, speed, and horizon length.
paper_authors: Zelin Gao, Qiuyu Wang, Jiapeng Zhu, Jingye Chen, Zichen Liu
